d:
Yah kovid aveyarnes siriz ka pahla vidiyo hai. ismen un vaigyanik sanbhavnaon ki charcha ki gaee hai jinse ham kovid sankat ki samapti ka anuman laga sakte hain. Endemic, Herd Immunity, Sero Survey, Strains & Variants tatha Vaccination jaisi dharnaon ke madhyam se anumanon ko spasht kiya gaya hai.
Is siriz ka uddeshy yah hai ki kovid ke sanbandh men jo aphvahen ya bhrantiyan hain, unhen dur kiya jae taki Pandemic ko Infodemic banne se roka ja sake. yah aasan bhasha men vaigyanik dharnaen spasht karte hue samaj ko nirasha aur duvidhaon se bachane ki pahal hai.
